findings.evidence: AUDIT_PLAN Wave M (line 145) enumerates 'conflict modal (partial-sent PENDING) · resolved · unresolved->cashier CTA'. The spec self-gates these via offlineConflictGated (spec:301-303): the kiosk-offline-conflict-cta only surfaces when a buffered entry is marked stale (KioskAppComponent.vue:819-822 getStaleEntries), which this run never seeded. No 06b-offline-conflict-modal artifact exists. The electronic reconcile-pending path (/api/frontend/payment/reconcile-pending) is also untested by design (Plan-B cash routing gates it; spec:59-65). NOT a defect (an unobserved state cannot fail) and does NOT block convergence — but the GREEN verdict covers ONLY the cash-buffer offline path; offline-CONFLICT resolution + electronic reconcile remain UNVERIFIED.
findings.fix_hint: Add a Wave M follow-up that seeds a stale buffered entry (86 an item while queued) to exercise the conflict modal -> resolved -> unresolved->cashier CTA chain, and a separate electronic-payment offline case to exercise reconcile-pending idempotency. Until then, do not represent Wave M as full-coverage.

findings.evidence: 2 of 9 PNGs do not visually show what their filename claims, because the snapshot fires at assertion-resolve without settling transitions/overlays. (a) 07: DOM proves the offline pill survived reload (class='kiosk-offline-indicator slide-down-enter-active slide-down-enter-to' = mid slide-down Vue transition) so the PNG caught the pill still animating in from above the top edge -> pill absent from frame though element present + assertion passed. (b) 09: DOM contains kiosk-error-network-title + cta-retry + cta-staff (assertions real, spec:356-358), BUT kiosk-init-overlay is still present (grep count 1) and the PNG shows the boot loader 'Demarrage en cours...' occluding the error screen. Playwright isVisible() ignores occlusion, so the assertion passes over a boot spinner. The assertions/DOM are sound; only the visual evidence is unrepresentative.
findings.fix_hint: Before snap(): for 07 await the slide-down transition to settle (await indicator transition end or fixed 600ms after toBeVisible); for 09 await page.locator('.kiosk-init-overlay').waitFor({state:'hidden'}) (same pattern already used at spec:128,313) before snapping the error/network screen.

findings.evidence: Offline cash-instruction screen reads 'Presentez votre numero a un membre de l'equipe' while 'Numero de commande' renders the synthetic placeholder '#—' (em-dash). A customer is literally told to present a dash. The synthetic '#—' itself is acceptable (author pre-blessed it; spec:262-263 only forbids literal 'undefined'/'null', and DOM confirms ' #—' with neither) — this is a distinct copy/UX wrinkle, not the technical null-render question.
findings.fix_hint: On the offline-buffered path, either suppress/soften the 'present your number' instruction when no real queue number exists yet, or show offline-specific copy (e.g. 'Votre commande sera transmise — un membre de l'equipe vous donnera votre numero'). Frozen-zone-adjacent (KioskCash/Payment components) — observe-only here; route any change through owner gate.

verdict_note: Wave M cash-buffer offline path is GREEN: boot 201 gate enforced, order survives reload (07 DOM), offline indicator visible (06) — NOT a silent hang, total identical online vs offline across 4 surfaces, single 201 replay on reconnect (no double-charge), indicator clears on recovery (08), no non-allowlisted console errors, no i18n raw-label leak. The core order-loss + silent-hang + double-charge paranoia points are all empirically rebutted.
